instruction: Make me an amazon account with monthly prime membership.
notes: The task creates a new amazon.User (signup with the supervisor's first/last name and email), verifies it through the code emailed to the supervisor's gmail (send_verification_code -> gmail login -> search inbox threads -> read thread -> verify_account), logs in, registers the supervisor's payment card on the new account (amazon.PaymentCard changes are ignored by the evaluation), and subscribes to Prime with duration monthly. Account state is modeled with nullary predicates (account-created / verification-sent / account-verified) because exactly one account is created. The amazon password is agent-chosen; amazon-signup asserts (password-for amazon ?pw) so amazon-login does not need (passwords-known), while gmail-login does. If amazon.signup already auto-sends a verification email, calling send_verification_code again is still valid; the agent should use the latest code. Supervisor name/email are taken from the task context (supervisor.show_profile could be called additionally but is not required). `monthly` is declared as a domain constant so supervisor-complete-task's precondition can mirror the goal literal (subscribed-prime monthly). token-for statics pin each app's token object to make plans deterministic.
